relationships.subject: epoNA5HT
relationships.evidence_quote: All the eVDs and epoxy-eVDs downregulated pro-inflammatory Il-6, Il-1β, and Tnf-α with 14′,15′-epo-NA5HT being the most effective overall (Fig. 5e–g).

key_findings: Epoxides of NADA and NA5HT are formed by microglial CYP epoxygenases and are anti-inflammatory.
epoNA5HT is a CB1 agonist and a 30-fold stronger TRPV1 antagonist than NA5HT, while epoNADA is a TRPV1 agonist.
